name: ts-generated-fact-evidence
description: A TypeScript file the analysis recognises as generated is one generated entry of the facts document under the evidence that decided it: the Go header form, an @generated tag, a do-not-edit notice and a convention row's generated directory. The line is the comment line that marks the file, the first line of a notice written over two lines, or 1 for a convention row, and the detail is that line's text or the row's name. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named nuxt for the package nuxt, holding the installed version in its range, which names .nuxt as a generated directory.
pending: bindings.2: deadset-ts writes the facts document's generated entries with each evidence, its marking line and its text (J3).
